meta_title: Complete Plumbing & Tiling | Bathroom Renovator Stoke-on-Trent
meta_description: Complete Plumbing & Tiling in Stoke-on-Trent. Full bathroom renovations, wet rooms, and tiling work. Free quotes, no call-out charge. Call 07866 527863.
hero_subhead: Transform your bathroom in Stoke-on-Trent with expert plumbing and tiling. From design to completion in weeks, not months.
services_heading: Complete Bathroom Renovation Services in Stoke-on-Trent
services_subhead: We handle every aspect of your bathroom transformation — from burst pipes to luxury wet rooms.

services.title: Full Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete bathroom redesign including new layout, plumbing runs, and tiling. We manage the entire project from planning to handover, ensuring minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Wet Room Installation
services.desc: Bespoke wet rooms with proper waterproofing, sloped floors, and drainage. We use premium tanking systems to guarantee a leak-free, maintenance-free finish.

services.title: Tiling & Wall Finishes
services.desc: Ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiling for walls and floors. We cut and fit around obstacles with precision, leaving no gaps or uneven grout lines.

services.title: Shower Installation & Repair
services.desc: From electric showers to power showers and walk-in enclosures. We fit new units, repair existing systems, and fix leaks that waste water and money.

services.title: Plumbing & Pipework
services.desc: New pipework for baths, showers, basins, and toilets. We reroute existing pipes to suit your new layout, test for leaks, and guarantee safe, efficient water supply.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, blockages, and radiator issues fixed same day. We carry parts on the van and aim to be with you within two hours of your call.

about_pullquote: We finish every job like we'd live in it ourselves.
about_para_1: Complete Plumbing & Tiling was founded in 2010 by Mark Davies, a qualified plumber and tiler frustrated by half-finished jobs and poor aftercare. Over 15 years, we've transformed over 380 bathrooms across Stoke-on-Trent and surrounding areas. Every team member holds current plumbing qualifications, and we're fully insured and gas-safe compliant for any gas work.
about_para_2: We're known locally for turning up on time, respecting your home, and standing behind our work with a 10-year guarantee on all tiling and waterproofing. Most of our work comes from word-of-mouth referrals and repeat customers — because we treat every bathroom like it's our own. If something isn't right, we come back and fix it.

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Gutted our bathroom and redid the lot — new suite, wet room, all the pipework. Mark and the lads were here five days flat, kept the mess to a minimum, and the workmanship is spot on. Had a small grout issue a month later, they came back and sorted it without any faffing. Proper job.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Called them for an emergency leak in our ensuite. They came same day, found a cracked pipe under the tiles, and explained exactly what had happened and how they'd fix it. Price was fair, no surprise bills. The tiling work they did while they were at it looks professional. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: After three other quotes, Mark gave us the most honest answer and the best price. Replaced our shower and re-tiled the whole bathroom. Friendly lads, turned up early most days, cleaned up after themselves. The shower is brilliant and never leaks. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Tony H.
